verdict.rationale: Svelte with SvelteKit is a full-stack web framework, comparable to Next/Nuxt per the docs, so scheduled or recurring server jobs are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack documents no cron, scheduled-task or recurring-workflow capability. Reactive `$effect`, prerendering/ISR and the MCP server are related-but-different features and are not recurring schedules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
